pages.title: Ledgerly — bookkeeping for freelancers who hate bookkeeping
pages.text:
Bookkeeping for freelancers who hate bookkeeping.
Ledgerly sorts your bank transactions into income and expenses automatically.
Freelancers lose evenings every quarter matching receipts to bank lines.
Snap a receipt with your phone and Ledgerly matches it to the right transaction.
See what to set aside for taxes every time you get paid.

pages.title: Pricing — Ledgerly
pages.text:
Pricing
Try Ledgerly free for 30 days.
After that it is $12 per month, billed monthly.
Export everything to CSV or send it to your accountant in one click.
Available in the US, UK and Canada.

pages.title: Security — Ledgerly
pages.text:
Security
Ledgerly connects to your bank with read-only access through Plaid.
We never store your bank login.
Data is encrypted in transit and at rest.
